decided: Madhav, 2026-10-24 01:13 Toronto, in chat: "Yes to all" to the ten items of claude/review-2026-10-24-crypto-7-days-brutal.md (the brutal 7-day review of crypto Ananta, 17-24 Oct 2026).
written_before: every rule below was written on 24 Oct 2026 before it ran once; the numbers do not move without a new entry in history

1_pause_zone_touch.what: ZONE_TOUCH, ZONE_TOUCH-UA/-UB/-UC take no new paper trades (strategy_status PARKED; the trade guard refuses every book that is PARKED). The 218 open ones keep recording to their own exits.
1_pause_zone_touch.why: 123 closed in the week, every one by stop, median -11.3%, net -$1,638; scoreboard -13/100 on all three tiers.

2_pause_e6.what: The Explorer runs ruleset W3 = W2 without the E6 dip setup (src/intelligence/explorer_engine.py).

3_protect.what: Every open paper trade that has a stop: when the high reaches entry + 1.5 R (R = entry - first stop) the stop moves to the entry; from +2.5 R it trails 1 R under the high. Live for the brain's trades, on the daily candle for every other book. Never for the $500 account (item 4 has its own rules) and never for a trade with no stop (DIP, H07, the random baselines).
3_protect.why: GAVE_BACK x5 in the brain's last 13 trades; every close this week was a stop or a date.

4_core.what: The $500 book's core reads the cash target Madhav approved: CLOSED 70% (no core), FRAGILE 40%, CONFIRMED 15%. The core may hold at most min(60%, 1 - cash target) of the book, split BTC 2 : ETH 1, and is trimmed back to that cap when it is more than 5% of the book over it (one trim a session). FRAGILE (Bitcoin less than 3% above its 50-day): hold what is held, no adds; with no core, a first buy of at most 20% of the book. CONFIRMED: thirds, the first at most 20% of the book, the next only after a daily close above the 20-day average in a later session. Each coin's invalidation is its own 50-day average: a daily close under it sells that coin's core. A core bought before core-v2 gets its invalidation written at the first step.
4_core.why: 60% in within hours of the dial opening on 11 Oct; 40% idle for 13 days; the 22 Oct brake fired instead of a plan.

5_one_plan.what: One plan line per night (discipline.plan_line) reconciling the stance, the brain, the bold book and the officer; where they conflict the stance wins and the conflict is a LAYER_CONFLICT finding.

6_wait_for.what: Every PASS names wait_for (a price level, a dial state or breadth) that would turn it into a TAKE; the next night the card says 'arrived' when the condition came true, even if the brain still passed.
6_wait_for.why: 24 templated passes; ARK, COMP, BEAMX seen and ignored.

7_selection_floor.what: The brain's book: no tier-C entries; no entry within 2% of the top of its zone; stop at most 8% away. The code turns such a TAKE into a PASS with the floor named.

8_officer_checks.what: Nightly checks with a state each: cash idle more than 5 days above the cash target; a core position without an invalidation; any book down more than 2% of its start in 7 days; any explorer setup with COSTS_ATE over 50% of its closed trades. A failed check is filed on the repair board once a week.
8_officer_checks.why: 'Nothing changed in the account today' seven days running.

9_rx_cr.what: The reconstruction loop on crypto (jarvis/service/reconstruct.py, RX-CR v1): a card a night with typed findings (GAVE_BACK, MISS_PATTERN, BOOK_BLEED, LAYER_CONFLICT, SELECTION, WAIT_ARRIVED), lanes by code, SAFE rows to the repair board, DECISION rows to the queue for Madhav.
9_rx_cr.why: Crypto logs everything and learns nothing.

10_breakout_shadow.what: The breakout family BRK: a daily close at a 20-session high on volume at least 1.5x its 20-day average, tier A and B only, stop 8% under the entry, the protect rule, out after 20 days. Shadow books BRK, BRK-UA, BRK-UB; judged against RANDOM_20D and the market after 20 sessions; nothing live.
10_breakout_shadow.why: The only catches of the +25-30% movers came from a banned rule; the real family is missing.

core.next_tranche_needs: a daily close above the 20-day average, dial CONFIRMED, at least one session after the last tranche

history.what: item 4 coded as Madhav approved it: the first version read FRAGILE as 'a third of the core' and would have trimmed two-thirds of BTC and ETH at the next close; the approved rule is the 40% cash target, which the book already meets (41%). Caught on the first dry run before any fill.
